summary: Workers/D1 adapter for the model gateway data plane (#347, streaming #348): gateway-core GatewayPorts over D1 and createGatewayApp mounted at /gateway/v1/* by routes/gateway.ts, which passes ctx.waitUntil so a disconnected stream still settles. Guide: apps/docs/guide/gateway-data-plane.md.
context_hints: Decisions (routing, holds, pricing, coded errors, the HTTP flow) live in @clash/gateway-core; these files only make them durable. Never re-implement them here.
D1 columns are unix seconds, gateway-core is epoch ms: convert through d1-common.ts only.
Identity is the sk_gw_ token (services/gateway-tokens.ts) with the models:invoke scope; no header, x-user-id included, is identity.

Official upstream secrets: secret_ref may only name a GATEWAY_UPSTREAM_* Worker secret or Secrets Store binding; envelopes are sealed under GATEWAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY, which must differ from ACTION_SECRET_KEY (tenant BYOK) or sealed keys fail closed. No key material in errors, logs, audit or the ledger; views show a short keyPrefix only.
Unimplemented ports (scheduler, audit) are unavailablePort (501), never silent no-ops.

Abuse (#356): the data plane counts requests/401s per minute (gateway_abuse_observation, fingerprint hashed from cf-connecting-ip + user agent) and refuses suspended tenants/keys with GATEWAY_SUSPENDED; thresholds are evaluated by the scheduled handler (evaluateGatewayAbuseNow).

Body retention (#353, decision 2026-10-20): blobs = R2 (R2_BUCKET, prefix gateway-retention/), retention = D1 gateway_request_retention metadata only. On only when GATEWAY_STAFF_PROMPT_ACCESS=enabled (hosted); purge runs regardless from the scheduled handler. Never store headers or upstream credentials. Streams are retained as delivered, capped; a cut copy is response_truncated = 1 (0039).
Stale holds (#348): sweepGatewayHolds (d1-budgets.ts) runs from the scheduled handler and POST /api/v1/admin/gateway/holds/sweep; it never touches settle_failed holds.

Each operation is one changes()-chained batch with a CHECK-violation guard; ledger request ids are the idempotency anchors.

key_files.d1-billing.contract.test.ts: gateway-core's shared billing contract (#425) on the D1 adapters; Postgres runs the same suite in apps/api-node.

key_files.d1-upstream-health.ts: #350 gateway-core upstreamHealth over gateway_upstream_health (0043): circuit counters per official account, a failure counted in one upsert (no lost counts), epoch ms columns.
key_files.upstream-keys-migration.test.ts: 0043 on node:sqlite: key_serial carried from in-place rotated versions, draining-version triggers, failure-count CHECK.
key_files.d1-budgets.ts: All-or-nothing reserve in one batch (CHECK-violation guard rolls back; only hard budgets refuse, soft/alert hold past the limit and the same batch inserts gateway_budget_event rows returned as flags), single-batch settle writing per-budget settle rows; ledger reads. No budget row = refused. expiredHolds/expire + sweepGatewayHolds: open holds past expires_at -> expired with a zero-cost expired settle row, once.
key_files.d1-limits.ts: rate_limit_json (gateway-core GatewayRateLimitSchema: rpm/tpm/concurrency/mediaJobs) from key / member (tenant_member, 0041) / model / tenant (tightest of subscription and tenant.rate_limit_json), counted in gateway_rate_window and gateway_inflight (0034) under tenant-scoped subjects (tenant:<t>...). Malformed config fails closed.
key_files.d1-common.ts: Time conversion, monotonic clock, published-catalog subquery, JSON helpers, the gwu_ official account id prefix.
key_files.d1-media-jobs.ts: #359 gateway_media_job (0049): one official media job per hosted generation task (ledger request id, frozen GatewayMediaJob, forward-only status planned -> admitted -> settled | refused), and loadGatewayProductIdentity (a product user in a Project's tenant, member required; tenant wallet + member budget).
key_files.d1-admin-audit.ts: #353/#394 the one gateway_admin_audit writer (actor = kind + id: an admin account, or a product user acting through a team role): adminAuditStatement (a statement for the mutation's own batch, chained on changes()) and redactAuditValue (secret keys and credential-shaped values become [redacted]). Rows are append-only (0036 triggers).
key_files.d1-catalog-admin.ts: #353 catalog admin over gateway_model: list (live marked), clone into a draft, upsert/remove draft models (ModelCardSchema + DeepSeek Flash-only policy), publish (the whole version, then immutable).
key_files.d1-upstream-admin.ts: #353/#350 official upstream accounts: list/create/update/disable, rotate (adds vN+1; the previous version drains, or drain:false revokes it) and revokeKey (ends a drain or rolls back), each one batch with its audit row and a circuit reset. Secrets are write-only; views carry kind, field names, key version, keyPrefix, binding presence and circuit health; audit rows carry versions only.

Each write + audit in one CAS batch.
